content.what_it_is: Fortran breaker module whose WAVE_BREAKING dispatcher (L59-L74) invokes artificial-viscosity breaking or wavemaker viscosity, and whose BREAKING routine (L86-L354) computes local onset/age propagation from surface time/space gradients, assigns wavemaker or depth-scaled eddy viscosity, and derives roller flux and undertow components.
unresolved: AGE is declared INTENT(OUT) at L111, which makes its incoming contents undefined on entry, but it is read to decide onset/continuation at L151-L156 and neighbor AGE values are read at L182-L224 before every element is definitely assigned; the implemented interface requires INOUT semantics.

DXg and DYg are assigned only in the nested non-VIS_DEPTH_RATIO path at L160-L167 when the L151 onset condition is false and the L154 age condition reaches its ELSE, but they are used unconditionally for xmk/ymk at L238-L243; onset cells and already-aging cells therefore use unassigned coordinate spacings.

With VIS_DEPTH_RATIO enabled, the Fortran IF opened at L132 has no ENDIF before the preprocessor #else at L143; its apparent closing ENDIFs at L226-L229 belong to the excluded #else branch, so that compile-time branch has an unterminated IF. In the same branch B is used at L141 without assignment when ETAt<=tmp1 because L136-L140 has no default.

The AGE sweep covers Ibeg-1:Iend+1 and Jbeg-1:Jend+1 at L117-L118, while quadrant propagation reads AGE at I-1/I+1 and J-1/J+1 at L182-L224; extreme iterations require indices two cells beyond Ibeg/Iend/Jbeg/Jend without a local Nghost or bounds check.

ATAN2 is converted to [-180,180] degrees at L129, but quadrant tests cover [-180,-90), [-90,0), [0,90), and [90,180) at L181-L224; an ANGLE value exactly +180 satisfies none of them and skips neighbor-triggered age propagation.

ROLLER_FLUX, UNDERTOW_U, and UNDERTOW_V are assigned only on the continuing-breaking path at L336-L340; wavemaker cells and nonbreaking outside cells update nu_break without clearing these three arrays, permitting prior-step values to persist unless another routine clears them.
The GLOBAL ONLY list repeats Xc_WK and Yc_WK at L89-L92, a duplicated import consistent with copy/paste drift; local cap2 at L101 is declared but never used.
VIS_KENNEDY_ORIGINAL divides by T_star and VIS_STATIC_TRANS divides by T_brk without a positive-value guard on MinDepthFrc/depth or T_brk.
